thread:
alice: Heads up, eu-west dedicated pool had a sudden latency tail at 09:42 UTC. Correlates with SNAT ports depletion on nat-gw-eu-west-1.
ben: saw it too. small requests (100-300 tokens) spiked from 20ms p95 -> 380ms. Load shows a massive new_conn rate to kv-store-replica-3.
chloe: infra-bot: ALERT snat-port-pressure nat-gw-eu-west-1 98% inuse. Possible ephemeral port exhaustion from many short TCP connects.
infra-bot: ACTION: create-change route heavy-tenants -> nat-gw-eu-west-2 (temp).
alice: I'm worried this is a noisy-tenant case where a tenant's SDK opens a fresh TLS per request. We should try handshake reuse or an outbound proxy to multiplex.
ben: short-term mitigation: flip traffic for top offending tenants to nat-gw-eu-west-2. Longer term: add per-tenant connection-pooling guidance and SDK defaults.
chloe: We can also enable a per-node outbound TCP mux (node-proxy) to collapse many upstream connections. Prototype exists but not shippable without perf tests.
oncall: oncall applying routing change now. I'll also apply a temporary envoy filter on canary nodes to limit new_conn bursts per tenant to 2k/s.
alice: Add telemetry: per-nat-gw ephemeral_ports_in_use, per-tenant new_conn_rate, per-node conntrack_util. Alert at 80%/10k new_conn/s/70%.
ben: Cost note: spinning up a second nat-gw per region ~+$1k/month plus data processing. Per-tenant proxy costs depend on qps and TLS CPU. Estimate later.
chloe: For safety add guardrail: if nat-gw-eu-west-2 SNAT > 95% for >5m revert change and page infra-pager.
oncall: change applied, nat-gw usage dropped to 46%. Monitoring.
infra-bot: RESOLVED snat-port-pressure nat-gw-eu-west-1. Follow-ups created: telemetry PR, envoy new_conn limit rollout, SDK pooling doc, eval of node-proxy vs dedicated nat-gw.
alice: I'll open the postmortem stub and ping SEs for the likely noisy tenant to adopt keepalives and HTTP/2 multiplexing.
ben: also add a runbook entry "egress-snat-exhaustion" with quick remedial steps.
chloe: long term we should evaluate moving internal kv traffic to private VPC endpoints to avoid SNAT entirely for sensitive tenants. Security review needed.
alice: thanks all, closing loop after 24h monitoring.
